str.desc: Unable to save the results of calibration due to the values being outside of the valid range.

str.text: A velocity of zero cannot be calibrated. Enter a non-zero value and start again.
str.desc: Unable to perform axis calibration move since velocity is 0.

str.text: The distance of the calibration routine must be at least %1 to move for the minimum required time of %2 seconds. Enter a distance greater than %1 or adjust the speed and try again.
str.desc: Calibration time will be too short. %1 = minimum distance. %2 = minimum time in seconds.

str.desc: %1 = axis name.

str.text: The positive and negative limits cannot be set to the same position.
str.desc: The user requested that both the negative and positive position limit be equal in value.

str.text: The zero position is outside the requested positive %1 and negative %2 limits. Move the zero position or request new limits.
str.desc: Invalid limits. %1 = positive limit. %2 = negative limit.

str.text: The rated shunt voltage must be greater than zero.
str.desc: User must enter in a shunt voltage more than 0.

str.text: The rated shunt amperage must be greater than zero.

str.text: Calibration results saved successfully.
str.desc: N/A

str.desc: %1 = current position. %2 = first limit. %3 = second limit.

str.text: The measured distance results in a resolution (%1) that deviates more than %2% from the weld head's original resolution (%3). Enter in a new measurement or re-calibrate the limits.
str.desc: %1 = new volts per inch. %2 = limit percent. %3 = weld head volts per inch.
